In the wide-band limit the self-energy is a constant,
\begin{equation}
\Sigma \equiv -\frac{i\Gamma}{2} ,
\label{eq:wb}
\end{equation}
so it is even in frequency,
\begin{equation}
\Sigma(\omega) = \Sigma(-\omega) .
\label{eq:even}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
